robot.name: DOBOT ATOM

currentness.currentness_notes: Treated as commercial_deployment based on reviewed sources as of 2026-05-16.

payload.original_value: 3.5 kg single-arm payload without dexterous hand/gripper

battery.original_value: about 2 h battery life; about 2 h charging
battery.notes: DOBOT-copyrighted user guide lists about 2 h battery life and about 2 h charging for Atom Max/Trainer.

degrees_of_freedom.notes: Product page describes Atom Max as 41-DoF; user guide lists 29 body DoF without dexterous hands/gripper.

walking_speed.notes: Official figure, added 2026-10-29 by automated spec fill; Maximum walking speed; listed for DOBOT Atom-Max and Atom-Trainer, with '-' for Atom D. Separate arm maximum end speed is also 1.5 m/s..

hands.description: Atom Max configuration lists two 6-DoF dexterous hands; Trainer supports optional dexterous hands or grippers.

compute.description: Basic Intel i5 compute; optional high-compute module lists Intel i9, dedicated GPU, and 1500 TOPS AI module.
